the biomass of 50-year-old P. orientalis plantation in Xuzhou limestone mountains was about 54.35t·hm-2,and the allocation of biomass was trunk>branch>leaves>root.

(1) Biomass of P. orientalis plantation in limestone mountains of Xizhou is in a relatively high level;(2) Biomass allocation to organs followed the sequence of trunkbranchleaves or trunkleavesbranch,with the trunk biomass taking up the highest proportion in the total biomass;(3) Biomass and productivity of P. orientalisis plantation in limestone mountains were affected by the aspect index and stand density.
The main takeaway from our work is that
biomass and its influencing factors in the limestone mountains were similar to those in other areas of China.

the aboveground biomass is the main part of the biomass of the Platycladus orientalis plantation, and the biomass of the stand is closely related to the stand density and north aspect index, which provides a reference for the management of Platycladusorientalis forest in the limestone mountains.

the biomass of Platyclatudus orientalis plantation can be accurately calculated by its diameter at breast height,which can provide a scientific basis for the carbon accounting of Platyclatadus orientalis plantatioin.
